messages:
sam: Hey team — PR ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4872

sam: Summary: moving on-prem secret storage to KMS-backed vault path, changes env secrets -> KMS wrapped, updates auth flow for onprem agents. Need security + privacy sign-off before merge. Can someone +1 approvals and confirm merge window? :pray:

jess: I can take a look. Do you have a list of which secrets are moved and whether any plaintext still in logs?

sam: added a short checklist in the PR comment. moved: ONPREM_DB_PASSWORD, ONPREM_SERVICE_KEY. No plaintext in logs; added masking. Also added an integration test that runs locally via `./scripts/local-kms-emulate.sh`

raj: left a couple inline comments re: token rotation codepaths. Also need to add a migration step for existing VMs. pls add `docs/onprem/migration.md` or mention the command to migrate

morgan: KMS question — are we using customer-managed keys (CMK) or the platform-managed HSM? If CMK, need the key ARN + IAM policy scope. Also will this require a rolling restart for dedicated hosts?

sam: using CMK per customer opt-in. PR includes `kms_key_id` flag. Migration is a rolling restart; added commands:
``
# migrate secrets
./cli secret migrate --env onprem --kms-id <key>
kubectl rollout restart deployment/onprem-agent
```

sec-bot: policy-check: FAILED — missing `kms:Encrypt` permission in the example IAM snippet. See https://internal-policies/kms

sam: thanks, fixed the IAM example in the PR. also added `security-check: yes` label

jess: quick ask from privacy: does this change affect telemetry or leak metadata to cloud? if yes, need privacy review.

elaine: I'm privacy — quick skim shows no telemetry changes, but need a short PI assessment in PR (1-2 lines) confirming no PII exposure. I can +1 after that.

sam: added PI note to PR: "no PII or user-identifiable tokens are stored; only encrypted service keys are moved to KMS."

elaine: ok from privacy side, +1 pending IAM tweak noted by sec-bot (once fixed)

raj: LGTM after my inline comments addressed. I'll give final approve once sam updates migration doc.

sam: updated docs and IAM. tagging `security-review:approved`. planning to merge tomorrow 12:30pm PT during low traffic window. anyone object?

jess: no objections. :thumbsup: 

morgan: fine with merge schedule.

elaine: fine from privacy.

sam: Thanks all — merging at 12:30pm PT. Will ping when done.
